claims: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California.
The launch occurred on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The launch occurred at 7:49 p.m. PT.
The first-stage booster of the SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket landed on a drone ship in the Pacific Ocean.
The mission followed a previous day's scrub.
The mission was visible across Southern California.
This video shows the Falcon 9 rocket launching from California.
